description: Capture the current frame and return it as inline image data for the LLM to see. This supports still-image review only; QE capture may differ from actual video exports and cannot verify temporal animation.

time_seconds.description: Time position in seconds to capture. Uses current playhead if omitted.

name: capture_frame

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true; on failure, diagnostic detail when the tool provides it.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Capture Frame
